messages:
Alex Chen: Post-deadline triage for the payment-routing milestone — quick async check. What actually shipped vs slipped? Owners + next-step asks. @Maria_Gomez @Samir_Patel
Maria Gomez: Shipped: routing v2 + canary rolled to us-west. Slipped: failover docs and billing-edge tests (they're flaky). Owner for billing tests: @Samir_Patel
Samir Patel: Ack. Tests failing due to a KV-cache race on long sequences. Working on a repro + fix. ETA: EOD tomorrow. I need access to dedicated dev infra to run the reproducer (test-node-7). @eng-infra?
Julie Park: I can open access. Filing infra ticket now (infra-4567) and will update when nodes are ready.
deploy-bot: infra-4567 created by Julie Park — estimated completion 2h.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Question: do we rollback the canary until tests pass? Current canary error rate ~0.8% — borderline. @Julie_Park any infra risk to pausing?
Samir Patel: The spike is long-tail only; most traffic is fine. I'll push a short-term mitigator: lower in-flight requests for canary. Patch (draft): 
```yaml
route: payment-routing
canary: true
max_inflight: 12
```
That should reduce the reproduction rate while I fix the root cause.
Maria Gomez: Sounds reasonable. Once Samir lands the mitigator I'll re-run billing-edge. If green, we keep canary and schedule promotion by EOW.
Julie Park: infra-4567 completed — test-node-7 accessible. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Nice. Action list to capture: 1) Samir: PR with mitigator + repro logs, 2) Maria: run regression on billing-edge after PR merged, 3) Alex: update milestone doc and coordinate promotion if green. Anyone else to add?
Samir Patel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/sam/p/r/1234 — links to payment-789. ETA for merge: tomorrow AM (will add test results in thread).
Maria Gomez: Starting regression now, will paste results here.
deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.6% latency_p95=210ms (post-mitigator sample window).
Alex Chen: Great progress — I'll update the quarter milestone doc with shipped items, slipped items, and the unblock plan. Will ping PMs after we have regression green. Thanks everyone.
Maria Gomez: Outlining follow-ups in the milestone doc now.
Samir Patel: Will post final test logs here once I have them.
Alex Chen: Closing this async triage for now; will re-open if blockers appear.
